components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one ink-filled action on a surface. Hover to Ink Deep. Focus ring 3px Focus Blue with 3px offset.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ink outline on sheet white. Used for Try again on failures. Hover to Sheet Wash.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1b1f24); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--sheet, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #1b1f24); font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--wash, #f5f6f3); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #0b5cad); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Disabled Button
components.description: Hollow mark: sheet fill, control-line stroke, muted ink text. Never a grey fill. The Ask action is in this state until a question is typed.
components.css: .ds-btn-disabled { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--control-line, #6f7985); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--sheet, #ffffff); color: var(--ink-muted, #4a525c); font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.css: .ds-board { display: grid; gap: 16px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-outline { --cat: #3d4650; padding: 12px 14px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--cat); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-outline.is-empty { border-style: dashed; } .ds-outline-safety { --cat: #b3261e; } .ds-outline-maintenance { --cat: #1d4f91; } .ds-outline-quality { --cat: #1f6b43; } .ds-outline-operations { --cat: #3d4650; } .ds-outline-title { margin: 0; color: var(--cat); font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.1875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-tools { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

components.name: Tool Tile
components.description: A source hung in its category: solid category fill, white text. Enters once with the hang animation.
components.html: Example maintenance manual9 passages
components.css: .ds-tool { display: grid; gap: 2px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--cat, #b3261e); color: #ffffff; animation: ds-hang 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) both; } .ds-tool-name { font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-tool-meta { font-size: 0.9375rem; opacity: 0.92; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @keyframes ds-hang { from { transform: translateY(-6px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tool { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The workspace is a shadow board. Each document category is a painted outline on a pale perforated ground; sources hang inside their category as solid tools, and an empty category is a dashed outline, so the gap is visible. Answers are read on white sheets, in ink, at reading size. The system serves plant floor supervisors who need the right procedure fast and need to check cited lines against their source.

Density is controlled: two columns on desktop, a 360px board beside a fluid reading sheet, stacking below 860px. Nothing decorates. Color carries category and state only, and the dark-ink primary action is the only ink-filled control. The layout refuses the sidebar-and-cards dashboard default, and there is no hero.
keyCharacteristics: Pale perforated board ground with white reading sheets
Painted 2px category outlines; dashed when the category is empty
Solid category-colored tiles for documents, with white text
One dark-ink primary action; secondary is an ink outline; disabled is a hollow mark
Body text at 17px or larger; the display face is for titles and labels only

rules.name: The Painted Outline Rule
rules.body: Category color lives only in outlines, outline titles, tile fills, and routed chips. Color carries category and state, and nothing is decorated with it.

rules.name: The Display Is Not Body Rule
rules.body: Barlow carries titles, outline titles, chip labels, and status labels. Atkinson carries all running text, including document names and excerpts.

rules.name: The Reading Size Rule
rules.body: Answers and excerpts are set at 1.0625rem or larger. Helper text steps down to 0.875rem and never carries answer content.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not cast shadows. Sheets separate from the board by color and a hairline, never by blur.

rules.name: The Printed Mark Rule
rules.body: A control state is drawn, not shaded. Primary is a filled ink mark; disabled is a hollow mark with a Control Line stroke. Grey fills are not used for state.

rules.name: The Solid-or-Dashed Rule
rules.body: The answer rule is solid when the status is answered and dashed for the five statuses that do not answer: insufficient-evidence, needs-clarification, blocked, out-of-scope, and failed.

dos: Do paint each category as a 2px outline in its own color, and make it dashed when the category holds no documents.
Do use one ink-filled primary action per surface; use the ink-outline secondary for everything else.
Do draw disabled controls as hollow marks with a Control Line stroke.
Do set answers and excerpts at 1.0625rem or larger.
Do reserve the display face for titles, outline titles, chip labels, and status labels.
Do draw the answer rule solid when the status is answered, and dashed for the five non-answer statuses.
Do keep every corner at 4px or below.
donts: Don't fill a disabled control with grey; use the hollow mark.
Don't use dashed lines for anything beyond empty categories, non-answer statuses, and the loader.
Don't add a second ink-filled action to a surface.
Don't apply category colors outside outlines, outline titles, tile fills, and routed chips.
Don't add shadows. The world has none.
Don't set running text in the display face, or use the monospace face for anything but line numbers.
Don't copy the 2.35rem reading-sheet offset, the 14px helper text, or the off-scale padding values as system values. They are one-offs.
